subject: Cannot log in after password reset
body: Since resetting my password yesterday I get 'invalid credentials' on every attempt, even with the new password from the email link. Two colleagues report the same.

subject: Invoice PDF shows wrong VAT number
body: Our July invoice lists our old VAT number. Please reissue with the updated one we submitted in June.

subject: API returns 500 on bulk export
body: POST /v2/exports with more than 5000 rows returns HTTP 500 since Monday. Smaller exports work. This blocks our nightly sync and our warehouse data is now two days stale.

subject: Feature request: dark mode in dashboard
body: Our night-shift operators would love a dark theme for the analytics dashboard. Not urgent, but it comes up in every internal survey.

subject: Data breach concern: shared report link visible without login
body: A report link shared by a colleague opens without any authentication in an incognito window. The report contains client account balances. Please advise immediately.

subject: How do I add a new user seat?
body: Answered by support: seats are managed under Settings > Team. Customer confirmed resolved.

subject: Webhook retries flooding our endpoint
body: Failed webhook deliveries are retried every 10 seconds without backoff, which triggered our rate limiter and is now causing an outage loop on our side. Can retries use exponential backoff, or can we pause deliveries?

subject: CSV import silently drops rows with accented characters
body: Importing our contact list drops every row containing names with accents (é, ü, ø). No error is shown; the rows are just missing afterwards. Looks like an encoding issue.

subject: EU dashboard down for all users
body: Since 07:40 UTC every user in our EU tenant gets a blank page and a 502 on /dashboard. US colleagues are fine. Our clinics cannot see today's schedule.

subject: Charged twice for August
body: Our card was charged EUR 1,240 twice on 1 August for the same Business plan invoice INV-88213. Please refund the duplicate.

subject: How do I set up SAML SSO with Okta?
body: We are moving to Okta. Which fields go into the SAML app (ACS URL, entity id) and do you support SCIM provisioning?

subject: API key committed to a public GitHub repo
body: One of our contractors pushed our production API key (starts with hl_live_) to a public repository about an hour ago. We deleted the commit but it was public for ~40 minutes. Please help us rotate it and check for misuse.

subject: Reports show times one hour off
body: Since the clocks changed, every scheduled report shows timestamps one hour behind our local time (Europe/Rome). The raw API values look right.

subject: Cannot find the audit log
body: Found it under Settings > Security. Thanks!

subject: Suspicious logins from an unknown country
body: Our admin account shows three successful logins from an IP range we have never used, at 03:00 local time. We did not authorise these. Please lock the account and tell us what was accessed.

subject: Would love a Slack integration
body: It would be great to get alerts in Slack instead of email. Is this on the roadmap?

subject: Mobile app crashes when uploading a photo
body: On Android 15 the app closes immediately when we attach a photo to a visit note. iOS works. Version 4.12.1.

subject: Downgrade to the Starter plan at renewal
body: We want to move from Business to Starter when our contract renews on 1 October. What do we lose, and will the price change be prorated?

subject: Invoice address update
body: Please change our billing address to 12 Harbour Road. Done, thank you.

subject: Checkout returns 503 for every customer
body: Our storefront checkout, which calls your payments API, has failed with HTTP 503 for every order since 11:05 UTC. We are losing sales right now.

subject: Export the full audit log to CSV
body: Our auditors need the last 12 months of the audit log as a CSV. The UI only shows 90 days. How can we get the rest?

subject: Search ignores the second word
body: Searching for 'blue shirt' returns everything containing 'blue', as if the second word were ignored. It used to match both words.

subject: Request a VAT-compliant invoice for Q2
body: Our finance team needs the Q2 invoices reissued with our VAT number and the reverse-charge note required in the EU.

subject: Bulk-edit user roles
body: We have 400 users. Changing roles one by one takes hours; could you add a bulk role editor?

subject: Reset 2FA for a departed employee
body: Handled by our admin, closing.

subject: Rate limit errors at 50 requests per minute
body: Our plan says 600 requests per minute but we get HTTP 429 above roughly 50. This started after yesterday's maintenance window.
